[[File:Blight-icon.svg|thumb]][[File:World_Lesser_Blight.png|thumb|left|A map showing the location of the Lesser Blight in the world.]]The '''Lesser Blight''' is a separate, isolated portion of the [[Great Blight]] that is located on the [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan continent]]. It directly corresponds latitudinally with the Blight in the [[Westlands]]. While it does show the effects of the [[Dark One]]'s influence, it holds very few [[Shadowspawn]], as all the [[Trolloc]]s and [[Myrddraal]] were hunted down and killed in the years following the [[Breaking of the World]], and as the Lesser Blight is cut off from the rest of the Blight, none are able to return. Some Shadowspawn such as [[Draghkar]] still live in the Seanchan Blight. Because Trollocs and Myrrdraal are extinct in Seanchan, the people of Seanchan are skeptical about the existence and dangerousness of Shadowspawn in the Westlands.
